##### Project general facts

Fairmont Marina Residences Abu Dhabi is an exceptional branded residential development set along the calm waterfront of the Arabian Gulf, offering a lifestyle defined by prestige, elegance, and resort-style luxury. Positioned within the iconic twin-tower landmark crowned by a dramatic arch, the project reflects refined Arabian-inspired design and timeless sophistication. Each residence is thoughtfully crafted to combine spacious layouts, premium finishes, and breathtaking sea views, creating a private sanctuary in one of Abu Dhabi’s most distinguished waterfront destinations.

Residents enjoy privileged access to the world-class facilities of Fairmont Marina Resort, including an expansive infinity pool, the renowned Willow Stream Spa, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and tennis facilities. Ownership also comes with exclusive dining privileges, access to hotel meeting rooms and business amenities, and a full range of resort services designed to elevate everyday living. In addition, homeowners benefit from global lifestyle privileges through special access to over 110 Fairmont, Raffles, and Swissôtel properties worldwide, as well as invitation-only Fairmont President’s Club benefits, including VIP concierge services, room upgrades, and preferred hotel rates.

Each residence is finished to a premium standard using high-quality materials that reflect the elegance and prestige of the Fairmont brand. The homes feature fully equipped kitchens and are offered furnished, providing a turnkey living experience that combines luxury, comfort, and the service standards of a world-renowned hospitality destination.

##### Location description and benefits

Find yourself perfectly placed to access Abu Dhabi’s key locations. Business meetings are now just a drive across the causeway, leisurely walks along the corniche mere minutes away, and the footpath outside your door leads you to countless entertainment options. At dusk, it draws you to enjoy breathtaking sunsets on your beach.

Here’s where you can truly see the world the way you want to. Let your gaze sweep across the horizon, unraveling the stunning and uninterrupted views of the ocean on one side and the city’s breathtaking skyline on the other.

With the Marina Mall literally on your doorstep, infinite lifestyle options are within your immediate reach. Schedule a leisurely lunch at its selection of international restaurants, choose the season’s new styles from the countless boutiques, or watch the latest releases on the silver screen. Watch from your balcony as the yachts from the neighboring Abu Dhabi Sailing & Yacht Club glide silently by. Here is where life is truly lived.
